title: CCPA & California Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free CCPA privacy request letter template to exercise your California Consumer Privacy Act rights. Request data access, deletion, or opt-out easily.
description: A comprehensive letter template to help California residents exercise their CCPA rights including data access, deletion, and opt-out requests. Includes step-by-step guidance for submitting privacy requests to businesses under California privacy law.

sections.heading: Letter Header
sections.content:
Date: [DATE]

To: [COMPANY_NAME]
Privacy Officer / Data Protection Officer
[COMPANY_ADDRESS]

Re: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Request

sections.heading: Personal Information
sections.content:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am a California resident writing to exercise my rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). My personal information is as follows:

Full Name: [YOUR_NAME]
Address: [YOUR_ADDRESS]
Email: [YOUR_EMAIL]
Phone: [YOUR_PHONE]
Account Number (if applicable): [ACCOUNT_NUMBER]

sections.heading: Request Type
sections.content:
I hereby request the following under the CCPA:

[SELECT_REQUEST_TYPE]

☐ RIGHT TO KNOW: Please provide me with the following information about my personal information that you have collected, used, disclosed, or sold in the past 12 months:
   - Categories of personal information collected
   - Sources from which personal information was collected
   - Business purposes for collecting personal information
   - Categories of third parties with whom personal information was shared
   - Specific pieces of personal information collected about me

☐ RIGHT TO DELETE: Please delete all personal information about me that you have collected, except where retention is necessary for legal compliance or other permitted purposes under CCPA.

☐ RIGHT TO OPT-OUT: Please opt me out of the sale of my personal information to third parties.

☐ RIGHT TO NON-DISCRIMINATION: Please ensure that I will not face discrimination for exercising my CCPA rights.

placeholders.label: Select Request Type
placeholders.defaultValue: Check the boxes below for your specific request

sections.heading: Identity Verification
sections.content:
I understand that you may need to verify my identity before processing this request. I am prepared to provide additional information as reasonably necessary for verification purposes. Please let me know if you require any additional documentation.

I am making this request as:
☐ The consumer whose personal information is the subject of this request
☐ An authorized agent acting on behalf of the consumer (if checked, please attach signed authorization)

sections.heading: Response Timeline
sections.content:
Please acknowledge receipt of this request within 10 business days and provide a substantive response within 45 days as required by the CCPA. If you need additional time, please notify me in writing of the extension and the reason for the delay.

Please provide your response in a readily usable format, and if you maintain my personal information electronically, please provide it in a portable and readily usable electronic format.

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
If you do not normally deal with these requests directly, please forward this letter to your Privacy Officer, Data Protection Officer, or appropriate department.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to your response.

Sincerely,

[YOUR_SIGNATURE]
[YOUR_PRINTED_NAME]
[DATE]
